sections.name: POST
sections.title: Toggle toss handler
sections.what: Checks for an admin, finds the match, flips its toss flag, and returns a message saying which way it went.
sections.why: Likely reason: a single toggle is the simplest way for an admin to mark the toss.
sections.watch_out: It flips the flag instead of setting it, so a repeated or concurrent press can undo the change.

summary: Lets an admin mark a match's toss as complete, or reset it, by flipping the flag.
purpose: Lets the team record that the toss has happened before scoring.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the toggle; the admin check suggests it is an internal tool.
how: 1) Checks the request is from an admin. 2) Reads the match id from the body. 3) Looks up the match and flips its toss flag. 4) Returns a message. On error it logs and returns a generic message.
inputs: A POST with a match id in the body and the admin session or key on the request.
outputs: A JSON message saying the toss was marked complete or reset, or an error message.
risks: The flag is flipped rather than set, so a repeated or overlapping press can undo the change.
debug: If the toss state is wrong, check the match row in the database and the logs for the toss route error.
